ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Stage decor
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Reusable Pickle steps that place decor things and lay floors on a map for a gallery capture, and remove them all again. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See StageDecor/README.md at the repository root.
They sit under a text of their own ("Nelim's Pickle Tools: ...") so they can never be ambiguous with Pickle's steps.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps.
